proposed_operation_restated: HVAC Installation campaign 24132507747: target_spend.cpc_bid_ceiling_micros 30000000 ($30.00) -> 65000000 ($65.00). ONE operation. NOT EXECUTED.
gate_that_was_set: At least 2 of the 3 HVAC Installation Primary conversion RECORDS dated 2026-09-01 had to be proven unique qualified leads before the ceiling could be raised.

measured_evidence.source: WhatConverts API v1 profile 105803, joined to Google Ads click_view by GCLID; counts only, no PII retained
measured_evidence.detail: Two WhatConverts leads carry a GCLID that resolves to HVAC Installation. One is a Web Form lead from a 2026-09-01 click and qualifies. One is a Phone Call from a 2026-08-21 click that does not meet the 60-second qualified-call rule. That is 1 unique qualified lead, not the 2 the gate required.

second_independent_reason_to_reject.finding: The $30.00 ceiling this package wanted to raise did not exist during the window whose economics were used to justify raising it.
second_independent_reason_to_reject.evidence: change_event 2026-09-04 16:56:51 America/New_York, client_type GOOGLE_ADS_WEB_CLIENT, user access@greenmarketingfl.com, field target_spend.cpc_bid_ceiling_micros, old_resource EMPTY -> new_resource 30000000. AC Repair and HVAC Repair received $25.00 ceilings in the same minute (16:56:20 and 16:56:34), also from an empty old_resource.
second_independent_reason_to_reject.consequence: Every click cited in the package's rationale - the $50.00-$62.13 converting clicks of 2026-09-01 - was bought under UNCAPPED Maximize Clicks. Raising the ceiling from $30 to $65 moves the campaign back toward the regime that produced $46.66 per valid click account-wide and a $2,972.96 measured CPQL against a $280 limit. The package's own premise is therefore inverted: those clicks are evidence against the raise, not for it.

what_would_reopen_this: A capped-regime measurement: at least 14 settled days and at least 40 valid clicks under the live $30.00 ceiling, joined GCLID-to-lead through WhatConverts, showing HVAC Installation CPQL at or below $280 AND impression share still losing materially to rank rather than budget. Absent that, no ceiling raise on any campaign is justified.
